test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b984b151fee7b05f5f597c5554dea5be12e7b83bc8fa4b4463665f409771c10.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For first box alternate series : 

 
• Alternately first column elements shifts in the downward anti-clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately second and fourth column elements shifts in the anti-clockwise direction. 
 
• Alternately third column element is replaced by new element and remains constant i.e 'L' is replaced by 'A' and 'O' is replaced by ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dabf174d5cf220c442c7adcab0722f0a296071f5662f460bcb29b1aab4508c1.png] '.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b32a6000c7563925f6cf7d83e8d0db05bd34b739afb9710a87cb5c96c7f48ba5.png] 

2) For second box alternate series :

 
• Alternately fourth column elements shifts in the downward clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately first and third column elements shifts in the clockwise direction. 
 
• Alternately second column element is replaced by new element and remains constant i.e ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7bd2070edc1f5de8a5ffa0ed7b7c76b99b43130960198600a818765e87543117.png] ' is replaced by '2' and ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a369478a5eca6fb96c60a9deb9e6b10e2760d8f9c454b2d786d6d38e63bc642b.png] ' is replaced by 'K'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8bcd2f82e37eb30d3359d28fcd6ea19ce4d751dbaa4c4a42bf1de0a265400ae4.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a14d1217bc816d2b967d2ad3676381032000f811ce38ef6de3a020932539886.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (3)’ is the correct answer.
